records.headline: 168.6 payments per second
records.detail: Lab test: all six validators ran on one 4-vCPU GitHub runner, with the once-per-block fee settlement from PR #133, which is not active on the live network. Per the PR, only the before/after ratio is meaningful; absolute numbers depend on the hardware.
records.hardware: one 4-vCPU ubuntu-24.04 GitHub runner hosting all six validators

records.headline: Same answer, bit for bit, on the computers we tested
records.detail: Llama-2-7B gave byte-identical output on Linux, Windows and Intel Mac with the scalar and the AVX2 kernel (6 of 6 runs, 16 prompts × 32 tokens). On a shorter test (2 prompts × 4 tokens) Apple Silicon matched too: 8 of 8 runs identical across the four platforms. SmolLM3-3B matched on Apple Silicon Mac, Intel Mac, Linux and Windows, scalar and SIMD (8 of 8), and an independent Python reference agreed. GitHub-hosted CPUs; GPUs not covered.
